backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor defining all core data types (Hotel, HomeStay, Booking, etc.) and state maps, with authentication helpers for admin/partner sessions and access control integration for a hotel room booking platform.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting that the HomeStayManagement frontend component was updated to remove client-side admin-only guards so all authenticated users can submit the add-homestay form.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON document containing one-to-two sentence summaries of all frontend source files, serving as a reference index for the project's React component and page structure.
frontend/index.html: Root HTML entry point for the Mantralayam Hotel Room Booking App, mounting the React app into a div#root and loading the main TypeScript module.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React application file that sets up TanStack Router with all page routes, QueryClient, ThemeProvider, LanguageProvider, inactivity timeout handling for customer sessions, and the root layout with Header, Footer, and auxiliary widgets.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminRoomM: Admin UI component for creating, editing, and deleting rooms with support for both admin-owned and partner-owned rooms, syncing data to backend storage and invalidating React Query cache on changes.
frontend/src/components/admin/BookingMan: Admin dashboard component that displays booking statistics (total, confirmed, pending) and lists all bookings, with a tabbed interface that also embeds the CustomerManagement component.
frontend/src/components/admin/CustomerMa: Admin component for viewing, searching, editing, and deleting customers, with CSV export/copy functionality and Google Sheets URL configuration for external data sync.
frontend/src/components/admin/HomeStayMa: Admin component for managing homestay listings via the backend actor, supporting create/edit/delete operations with fields for pricing, amenities, partner info, photos, and videos.
frontend/src/components/admin/HotelManag: Admin component for managing hotels using React Query mutations, with a dialog form for creating and editing hotel details including image file uploads with size/type validation.
frontend/src/components/admin/IssuesMana: Admin component that displays and manages reported issues, showing stats for total/open/resolved counts and allowing admins to toggle issue status or delete issues stored via issueStorage.
frontend/src/components/admin/Notificati: Admin notification panel that fetches backend notifications and syncs them to permanent local storage, displaying them grouped by category (bookings, payments, partner, logins, issues) with delete and collapse controls.
frontend/src/components/admin/PasscodeMa: Admin component for managing room passcodes, allowing admins to add or delete passcodes via the backend actor while keeping localStorage and React Query caches in sync.
frontend/src/components/admin/ReportsExp: Admin report export component that generates and downloads HTML/PDF reports for bookings and properties, supporting filters by date range, individual customer, or all customers.
frontend/src/components/admin/ReviewMana: Admin component for moderating customer reviews, displaying stats and a filterable/searchable list of reviews with the ability to delete individual entries.
frontend/src/components/admin/RoomManage: File content was not provided; no summary available.
frontend/src/components/admin/SMSNotific: Admin panel component that displays SMS notification history and statistics (total, sent, pending, failed) for booking confirmations, polling for updates every 10 seconds.
frontend/src/components/admin/TempleSpec: Admin component for managing temple special updates, allowing admins to add, edit, delete, and reorder image-based updates with descriptions and times, including Google Drive URL conversion.
frontend/src/components/AIChatWidget.tsx: Empty file with no content, representing a placeholder or removed AI chat widget component.
frontend/src/components/CustomerInfoModa: Modal dialog component that collects a customer's full name and phone number before proceeding with a booking, with basic validation and saffron-themed styling.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Minimal footer component rendering a centered copyright notice with a saffron-themed muted background.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Sticky navigation header with links for home, browse rooms, and bookings; handles logout for customers, partners, and admins; includes a language selector dropdown and dark/light theme toggle.
frontend/src/components/HelpFAQWidget.ts: A floating FAQ widget with search functionality that displays predefined Q&A items about booking, payments, temple timings, and amenities for a homestay platform near Sri Raghavendra Swamy Mutt.
frontend/src/components/LanguageProvider: A React context provider that manages the app's language state, persists it to storage, and exposes a translation function via the `useTranslation` hook.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: A simple layout wrapper component that renders a Header, Footer, and a TanStack Router `Outlet` for page content in a full-height flex column.
frontend/src/components/OfflineIndicator: A fixed-position badge component that monitors online/offline status and displays an 'Offline Mode' or 'Syncing data...' indicator, triggering a simulated data sync when connectivity is restored.
frontend/src/components/partner/PayoutTr: Partner dashboard component that tracks earnings and payout records for a specific homestay, displaying total earnings, pending balance, and payout history with the ability to request payouts.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: A modal dialog that prompts newly authenticated users (via Internet Identity) to enter their name and create a profile if one does not yet exist.
frontend/src/components/ReportIssueDialo: A dialog form that allows users to report issues (booking, payment, property, etc.) with contact details, saving the issue to local storage and creating a persistent admin notification.
frontend/src/components/ReviewSection.ts: A review section component that displays average ratings and individual reviews for a homestay, and allows verified customers to submit or admins to delete star-rated reviews.
A wrapper component that applies fade-in/fade-out CSS transition animations between route changes using TanStack Router's `useLocation`.
frontend/src/components/TimeoutReviewPro: A dialog that appears on session timeout to collect a star rating and optional feedback from the user, saving it as a service issue with an admin notification.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor using React Query, returning either an authenticated or anonymous actor based on the current Internet Identity, and invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
Custom hook that triggers a callback after 30 minutes of user inactivity, with rate limiting to prevent the timeout prompt from showing more than once per 24 hours.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an Internet Identity authentication context and hook using DFINITY's AuthClient, exposing login/logout functions, identity state, and login status to React components via a context provider.
frontend/src/hooks/useNotificationToasts: Custom hook that listens for custom `newNotification` window events and displays deduplicated toast notifications with category-specific emojis using the Sonner library.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Provides React Query hooks for CRUD operations on user profiles, hotels, homestays, bookings, notifications, and partner/guest profiles by wrapping an actor-based backend client.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet that configures Tailwind CSS and defines a saffron-gold Hindu-inspired theme with CSS custom properties for both light and dark modes, plus utility classes for glassmorphic effects and gradients.
frontend/src/lib/analytics.ts: localStorage-based analytics module that tracks and persists visitor counts, bookings, revenue, logins, partner edits, homestay views, and payments with helper functions for each event type.
frontend/src/lib/customerCsvExport.ts: Utility module for exporting customer data as CSV, supporting file download and clipboard copy with proper field escaping and date formatting.
frontend/src/lib/customerStorage.ts: localStorage CRUD module for customer records (name, phone) using phone-derived deterministic IDs, with upsert, search, and custom event dispatching for reactive UI updates.
frontend/src/lib/dataStorage.ts: Core localStorage data management module (schema v4.4) defining types and seed data for homestays, hotels, bookings, notifications, analytics, and temple specials, with versioned migration support.
frontend/src/lib/googleSheetsConfigStora: localStorage module for persisting and retrieving a Google Sheets URL configuration, with save, get, and clear operations that dispatch custom browser events on changes.
frontend/src/lib/i18n.ts: Lightweight i18n module supporting English, Telugu, Kannada, Tamil, and Hindi with a translation dictionary covering navigation, browse, booking, and room detail UI strings.
frontend/src/lib/invoicePrint.ts: Generates a printable/PDF-ready HTML invoice string for a given booking, including styled sections for booking details, dates, status, and print instructions.
frontend/src/lib/issueStorage.ts: Manages issue reports in localStorage, providing CRUD operations (create, load, update status, delete) for user-submitted support issues.
frontend/src/lib/notificationStorage.ts: Handles permanent admin notifications stored in localStorage, supporting add, delete, category filtering, and count aggregation with custom DOM events for real-time updates.
frontend/src/lib/reviewStorage.ts: Manages homestay reviews in localStorage with functions to add, delete, retrieve by homestay, calculate average ratings, and check if a booking has already been reviewed.
frontend/src/lib/roomStorage.ts: Provides localStorage-based CRUD operations for room and partner data, including helpers for password/passcode management, partner auth cache clearing, and price display formatting.
frontend/src/lib/smsNotifications.ts: Simulates an SMS notification system by storing booking confirmation messages in localStorage, with utilities for retrieval, filtering by room, statistics, and cleanup of old records.
frontend/src/main.tsx: React app entry point that mounts the root component wrapped with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/AdminAppPage.tsx: Admin dashboard page with password-protected login, tabs for managing hotels, homestays, bookings, passcodes, notifications, and temple specials, plus an analytics overview and theme toggle.
frontend/src/pages/BookingConfirmationPa: Displays a booking confirmation screen by fetching a booking by ID from local storage and showing details like hotel, homestay, check-in/out times, guests, and total price.
frontend/src/pages/BookingPage.tsx: Booking form page that lets a verified customer select check-in date/time, number of rooms and guests for a specific homestay, calculates a 12-hour fixed price, and submits the booking.
frontend/src/pages/BrowseRoomsPage.tsx: Lists available homestays fetched from the backend canister with search and room-type filtering, and prompts unauthenticated users for customer info before navigating to booking.
frontend/src/pages/CustomerLoginPage.tsx: Customer login page that uses Internet Identity for authentication and collects the user's name on first login before redirecting to the browse-rooms page.
frontend/src/pages/DownloadCenterPage.ts: A static page displaying project overview, file structure, and setup instructions for the Mantralayam Room Booking System, with download/copy buttons for source code resources.
frontend/src/pages/DownloadProjectPage.t: An empty file with no content or exports.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: The main landing page featuring a temple specials carousel with auto-rotation, landmark cards with Google Maps links, and navigation buttons for browsing rooms, with authentication-aware UI.
frontend/src/pages/MyBookingsPage.tsx: Displays a user's booking history sorted by date, with options to cancel bookings (via confirmation dialog) and print invoices, persisting changes to localStorage and firing notifications.
frontend/src/pages/NotificationsPage.tsx: Shows all persistent system notifications grouped by category (bookings, payments, partner, logins, issues) with summary count cards and a scrollable timestamped list.
Partner dashboard that fetches the authenticated partner's profile and room listings via TanStack Query and a backend actor, allowing inline editing of room price and availability with logout support.
frontend/src/pages/PartnerLoginPage.tsx: Renders a partner login form that authenticates via a password against the backend canister, stores session info in localStorage, and navigates to the partner dashboard on success.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentFailurePage.ts: Empty file with no content; likely a placeholder for a payment failure page.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentSuccessPage.ts: Empty file with no content; likely a placeholder for a payment success page.
frontend/src/pages/RoomDetailPage.tsx: Displays detailed information for a specific homestay including a photo carousel, amenities, ratings, and pricing, fetched by room ID from the backend canister.
frontend/src/pages/RoomSearchPage.tsx: Empty file with no content; likely a placeholder for a room search page.
frontend/src/pages/StandaloneRoomSearchP: Empty file with no content; likely a placeholder for a standalone room search page.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides utility functions for reading, storing, and clearing URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routes, with optional sessionStorage persistence.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending the default theme with custom colors (saffron, gold, sidebar, chart), border radii, shadows, and animations, using oklch color values and several plugins.
project_state.json: Tracks project state including a known authorization bug where only admins can add homestays, with a pending fix request to relax the backend guard to allow all authenticated users to create homestay listings.
